Downtown & Capitol.name: Downtown & Capitol
Downtown & Capitol.description: State-government and riverfront core with dense residential conversion and mixed-use infill along the Boise River.

North End & Hyde Park.name: North End & Hyde Park
North End & Hyde Park.description: Historic streetcar-era bungalow district with renovation-led permitting and neighborhood-conservation overlays.

Boise Bench & South Cole.name: Boise Bench & South Cole
Boise Bench & South Cole.description: Post-war residential bench south of the core with teardown/rebuild pressure and infill multifamily.

East Boise & Harris Ranch.name: East Boise & Harris Ranch
East Boise & Harris Ranch.description: East-growth edge with master-planned residential subdivisions and new-construction permitting.

West Boise & Vista.name: West Boise & Vista
West Boise & Vista.description: Established west-side residential corridors with steady redevelopment and corridor densification.

BoDo & Riverfront.name: BoDo & Riverfront
BoDo & Riverfront.description: Boise Downtown / riverfront entertainment district with hotel, retail, and residential tower permitting.
